_note: One reaction beat after a consequential event: at_gate is queued (not committed) before the player's message, so the first voice's boundary fires camp -> gate, a consequential event (/cp set commits its own boundary at once, before the player's line, which is not a consequence of this answer); yield_on_question is off so a first voice ending on a question to the player (the yield check runs before the reaction) cannot skip the reaction. Both beats run a director chain with reaction on and stop_on_transition false; the next chain step is a reaction by a member who has not spoken in this answer, recorded as a talk decision with source reaction and a speech event with origin reaction and the event's cause, at most once for that cause. Written for v3.0 plan 19 stage 2; live gate 2026-10-27 (see 19-talk-pacing.md). Model lane: send_generate drafts real voices; the assertions read code-made records only.
